Luxury Upgraded Villa | Fully Furnished | Private Pool | Skyline Views

Experience refined luxury living in this exceptional villa, originally designed as a 5-bedroom home and thoughtfully converted into a spacious 4-bedroom layout. Fully furnished and extensively upgraded, this residence offers privacy, elegance, and premium finishes throughout.

Property Details:

4 Bedrooms (All Ensuite)
Originally 5 Bedrooms, Converted to 4
Fully Furnished & Upgraded
Ready to Move In
Built-Up Area: 7,823 sq. ft.
Plot Size: 9,234 sq. ft.
Annual Rent: AED 2,000,000

Key Features:

Expansive master bedroom suite with dedicated dressing area
Optimal privacy with a well-planned layout
Separate formal living area ideal for hosting
Closed kitchen fitted with premium appliances
Large family living area with additional study space
Driver’s room and maid’s room
Private swimming pool with a separate majlis
Covered parking with automatic garage door
Stunning Burj Khalifa and Downtown skyline views
This villa is ideal for tenants seeking exclusivity, space, and high-end living in a prime location.

For more details or to arrange a private viewing, please contact us.
